research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12792 (57 FR 9165, PDF pages 135-136 of the 1992-03-16 issue; sha256 d98807b8...), headed Executive Order 12792 of March 12, 1992, National Commission on America’s Urban Families (the OCR spaces the words), matching the census register row (1992-03-12). The machine heading search did not resolve the heading; I confirmed it from the OCR heading line. Text and inventory: seven scopes cover sections 1 through the final termination subsection to the signature (the last scope holds sections 3(c), the next two subsections and the termination sentence); I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: Executive Order 12869 section 4(a) revokes Executive Order 12792, effective September 30, 1993 (section 6). The report deadline in section 2(b) and the report-relative termination are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text. Source note: the dossier lists an order located by number (Executive Order 12827) as a missing provision, so I cannot cite it as a later event; I did not rely on it.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12869 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the National Commission on America's Urban Families: its sections 1 through 3 concern other committees and its section 4(a) revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the Commission.
